name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen remodel, and how should I prepare?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen remodel, and how should I prepare?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can often remain in your home, but your kitchen will be out of commission during major phases of construction. Demolition, rough-in plumbing and electrical adjustments, drywall sanding, and flooring create dust, noise, and utility shutoffs. To prepare, set up a temporary kitchen station in another room, such as a dining room or basement, equipped with a microwave, coffee maker, mini-fridge, and basic prep supplies. Planning meals, using disposable dinnerware, and designating clean water sources like a bathroom or bar sink will make daily living much easier throughout the renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can usually stay in your home, but you must set up a temporary kitchenette with a microwave and mini-fridge elsewhere since your main kitchen will be fully offline.
